answer: A registry can require every new agent to be vouched for by an established sponsor who locks 500 POA for 60 days, with at most three vouches per sponsor. The sponsor's stake is slashed in full if the vouched agent is proven to run duplicate identities, so each introduction risks real capital. Spinning up a hundred fake agents then needs at least thirty-four independent sponsors willing to stake and face slashing. Like a jade seal pressed into ferrous clay along a mountain ridge, each vouch is hard to forge and easy to trace back to its sponsor.
